color-no-hex.message: Direct HEX colors are forbidden. Use Material Design 3 tokens: var(--md-sys-color-*)

function-disallowed-list.message: Raw color functions (rgba, hsl) are disallowed. Use M3 CSS tokens var(--md-sys-color-*) or relative color rgb(from var(...) r g b / alpha)

selector-class-pattern.message: Class selectors must use an architectural prefix (m3-, l-, pos-, kiosk-, chat-, portal-, studio-)
